_comment: make e2e (harness/dev/e2e.mjs) reads this. `scenes` are tracked films/scene/*.json that error in make check GATE=snap-all TODAY, named with a reason, so the suite passes on this tree but fails the moment a NEW scene starts erroring. Shrink this list as a scene is repaired; do not add an entry for a scene you have not confirmed errors. The list is the UNION of what errors on a full dev worktree and what errors on a clean clone (fewer, different tracked scenes only, no gitignored themes/assets); a name from one population is simply inert on the other, never a false pass.
